caption: The drawing depicts a single, centrally placed object that appears oval or rounded-corner rectangular in shape, resembling a braided rug. The interior of the object is filled with an intricate, tightly woven pattern rendered in varying shades of blue. Around the edge of the central blue area is a braided border comprised of alternating segments colored in muted red, green, beige, and gray tones. The background of the drawing is an off-white or cream color, evenly filled with no visible texture or pattern. The composition is symmetrical, with the object centered on the paper and taking up the majority of the visual space.
title: Shaker Rug
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
